input.isolation: new user and network namespace; loopback only

databaseAndFiles.reason: The isolated network namespace could not reach PostgreSQL; EventLoggingService swallowed its DB connection failures.

errorsAndRetry.connect: Expected forwarding failure because no real implant SessionsService was provided.

result.finding: StopTunnelAsync removes the initiator/listener but retains the TunnelPair dictionary entry.

limitations: End-to-end forwarding through a live implant was not attempted.
Tunnel Event rows were not persisted because namespace isolation intentionally cut PostgreSQL connectivity; equivalent EventLogging persistence was exercised in other scenarios.
